media.title: Tektronix 465 oscilloscope
media.creator: Tektronix; photograph via TekWiki, individual attribution not established

observations.observation: White frontplate surrounds a cyan rectangular graticule display with two luminous wave traces. Repeated channel gain knobs sit left, timing and trigger groups right, each delimited by thin rules. Black ribbed coaxial knobs have red variable centers; tiny uppercase legends follow calibrated circular scales. Physical connectors and screw heads make a bounded measuring instrument. Static artifact inspection only; no operating motion/timing measured.
